title: Event log line (log/events.jsonl)
description: One JSON object per line, append-only. Lets an AI reconstruct what the learner clicked and answered.

id.description: Unique id of the event, made on the device (a UUID). The server ignores an id it already has, so sending an event twice is harmless. Every progress event has one; older events have none.

type.description: Dotted name, e.g. topic.add, question.add, sheet.add, material.add, dojo.add, dojo.drills.add (new content; with subject), sheet.status, topic.status, topic.due, topic.review, topic.enabled, question.edit, topic.notes, openItem.done, check.done, quiz.start, quiz.answer, quiz.graded, quiz.gradeLater, quiz.applied, dojo.task, dojo.drill.start, dojo.drill.round, dojo.applied, ai.sync (the AI processed all results before it), dojo.answer, dojo.check, dojo.hint, dojo.solution, ai.request, ai.response, pack.import, progress (an answer or other change of progress; data.op says which, see src/progress/ops.ts).

ref.description: Id of the affected topic, sheet, session, request, ...
